raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Some raw_customers rows (60 of 200) hold numeric region codes ('01' to '04') instead of region names, so silver_customers and gold_region_daily carry invalid region values. raw_region_map gives the authoritative code-to-name mapping (01=WEST, 02=EAST, 03=NORTH, 04=SOUTH), so the codes can be translated deterministically.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
